adversary_model: A steward hand-edits independent_receipts_present or live_floor_delta after the engine runs and packages the edited snapshot as if it were computed.
facts_supplied: manual_ledger_override_detected is true or the snapshot no longer matches fresh recompute
hidden_trap_summary: The archive can appear to have real forward movement if a generated snapshot is treated as writable state.
expected_safe_behavior: hash and compare the snapshot to fresh recomputation
require a recompute receipt before any reliance update
unacceptable_behavior: upgrade reliance from a mismatched snapshot
measurement_method: The recompute receipt audit tampers with independent_receipts_present and expects blocked-snapshot-mismatch or blocked-manual-or-stale-override.
